title: Lap and sector analysis
description: Lap and sector analysis — provisioned openlaps endurance operations dashboard.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(concat(left(session_id::text, 13), ' UTC ', session_type, ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(track_name, ''), 'unknown track')), 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(concat(left(session_id::text, 13), ' UTC ', session_type, ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(track_name, ''), 'unknown track')), 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: stint
list.label: Stint
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.definition: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at
list.query: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at

list.name: lap_compare
list.label: Comparison lap
list.definition: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at
list.query: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.title: Lap-time scatter by driver and stint

targets.rawSql: SELECT crossed_at AS time, concat(COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ', stint ', COALESCE(stint_number::text, '-')) AS "metric", lap_time_s AS "Lap time" FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.description: One point per lap at the time it was completed, one colour per driver and stint. The legend gives each stint's best, mean and latest lap.

panels.title: Best theoretical lap from sector bests

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(crossed_at) AS time, to_char(make_interval(secs => sum(best_split_s)), 'FMMI:SS.MS') AS "Best theoretical lap" FROM (SELECT sector, min(split_time_s) AS best_split_s, max(crossed_at) AS crossed_at FROM v_lap_sectors WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND valid GROUP BY sector) best

panels.title: Identity-based sector comparison

targets.rawSql: WITH pick AS (SELECT CASE WHEN '$lap' = 'all' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') ORDER BY crossed_at DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap' END AS selected_id, CASE WHEN '$lap_compare' = 'all' THEN (SELECT lap_id::text FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND valid AND pit_status = 'track' ORDER BY lap_time_s LIMIT 1) ELSE '$lap_compare' END AS compare_id) SELECT a.crossed_at AS time, a.sector AS "Sector", concat('Lap ', a.lap_number) AS "Selected lap", to_char(make_interval(secs => a.split_time_s), 'FMMI:SS.MS') AS "Selected lap sector", concat('Lap ', b.lap_number) AS "Comparison lap", to_char(make_interval(secs => b.split_time_s), 'FMMI:SS.MS') AS "Comparison lap sector", to_char(a.split_time_s - b.split_time_s, 'S990.000') AS "Sector delta" FROM pick JOIN v_lap_sectors a ON a.lap_id::text = pick.selected_id JOIN v_lap_sectors b ON b.lap_id::text = pick.compare_id AND b.vehicle_id = a.vehicle_id AND b.sector = a.sector WHERE a.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' ORDER BY a.sector

panels.description: Pick two laps to compare sector by sector. With a picker left on All, the selected lap is the latest lap and the comparison lap is the fastest clean lap in the time range. Both pickers are keyed by lap_id, never by a possibly repeated lap number. The delta is signed seconds, selected minus comparison.

panels.title: Degradation by lap-in-stint

targets.rawSql: SELECT crossed_at AS time, lap_in_stint AS "Lap in stint", CASE WHEN clean THEN lap_time_s END AS "Lap time", CASE WHEN NOT clean THEN lap_time_s END AS "Excluded lap time" FROM (SELECT crossed_at, lap_time_s, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, stint_number ORDER BY crossed_at) AS lap_in_stint, (valid AND pit_status = 'track') AS clean FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$stint' = 'all' OR stint_number::text = '$stint')) laps ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.description: Lap time against the lap's position in its stint. Blue points are clean laps; red points are pit and invalid laps, shown but not part of the trend.
